content: Ɓi heɗ haf hayiɗ ñaamke Yeesu
Yeesu raakohu Betlehem ŋ kur kaŋ Yudee ŋ jamanoona Herod nikoh buur. Ɓi heɗ haf kurkohha pulohaaɗ-noh, ɓa hayya Yerusalem.
Ɓa meeksoheeɗa an : « A nde kuɓki han raaku, yi nikan buuriŋ Yawuut ci ? Ɓoo hotiɗ horiŋ ɗe ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh. Te ɓoo hay ne ɓoo ñaamuk ɗe. »
Wa Herod buuri kerah ineem, a feyuusa lool, a yi na ɓi Yerusalem jen.
A cohɗohha kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa
na jangɗohoh caŋ wa jen, a meekissa ɓa ɗiski Mucɗohi Gapohse joy rimohu.
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne : « A joy raakohu Betlehem ŋ Yudee ŋ ini woosuuɗi fiis wii :

content.text: “ Fu Betlehem ŋ kur kiŋ Yudee,
fu ɓaahɗi muk ŋ ci uup ƴissuut ŋ kur ciŋ Yudee
sagu pulohi kilifaani pulohan nga ɗa, kilifaani niiɗan cuuɓiŋ ngo Israayel. ” »

content: Herod ɓeeɗukka heɗ haf ca, a ɗaayya na ɓa, ne ɓa teeɓ ɗe hooliɗ, jamanooni hora hotkoh.
A tuuƴca ɓa Betlehem, a woosa ɓa ne : « Kaɗaat ɗu meeksoha kuɓki meeksoh hooliɗ, ɗu hot ɗe ɗah, ɗu woo so, ŋ nam ɗe kaɗ ñaamka. »
Wa heɗ haf ca sikɗuk buura po ƴutta, ɓa kaɗta. Hora ɓa hotee ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh pulissa, wa nikka ŋ fikiiɓa, wa kaɗeeɗa po wa tiimmba ɗiska kuɓka nik, wa tufukka.
Hora ɓa hotee, ɓa sumeen nga keeh-keeh po ɓa minisɗi.
Ɓa aassa ŋ kahna, ɓa hotta kuɓka na Maryaama yaay ɓa ; ɓa ƴekiɗta Yeesu, ɓa ñaamukka Yeesu. Ɓa puliɗta alala ɓa ɓayndohe, ɓa eɗta ɗe urus, cuuraay na miir
Ƴutta Kooh teeɓpa ɓa ŋ heeƴ ne, ɓa haadee ɗah, ɓa kinaat taamb ŋ Herod. Ɓa kooɗta waas wiiriis, ɓa dokukka kur ɓa.
Suseef na Maryaama saandohiɗ ŋ Misra

Wa heɗ haf ca coot, malaaka Heɗ ɓoo teeɓukka Suseef ŋ heeƴ, a woosa ɗe ne : « Suseef, Herod hey nakohe kuɓki waaku ne a ap ɗe, mbaa kurka fu ɓay kuɓki na yaay ɓa, fu saandoh Misra, fu nik nga po mbaɗna ŋ woyan na ɗa. »
Suseef kurukka, a ɓayya kuɓka na yaay ɓa ŋ ɗooƴ weka, a kaɗta na ɓa Misra.
Ɓa nikka nga po Herod kaannda. Ŋ ineem, ina Heɗ ɓoo woyee raakka, woo ki a taambɗee ŋ nguɓ woosuuɗ an : « Ŋ ɓeeɗkiɗ kuɓkiŋ ngo ne a pul Misra. »

Wa Herod inah ne heɗ haf ca ñaañoh ɗe ñaañoh, a ayrukka lool. A tuuƴohha ŋ kur kaŋ Betlehem na ina wila ne komaakca ƴaar ca raak kiis kanak ruhussa jen, apsaat. A kindoha ŋ jamanoona heɗ haf ca woyee ɗe.
Wa nikohha ɗaa findi woosuuɗi Yeremi woyohee wa, an :

content.text: « Hooso kerhuuɗ ŋ kur ki na woyse Rama,
ca fuɗ laayiɗ na rooy keeh-keeh.
A Rasel na fuɗe komaakciŋ ɗe,
ɓa kaaniɗ, weɗ tah a waaɗɗi giifɗu. »

content: Ŋ finho kakaan kaŋ Herod, malaaka Heɗ ɓoo teeɓukka Suseef ŋ heeƴ ŋ Misra,
a woosa ɗe ne : « Kurka, fu ɓay kuɓki na yaay ɓa, ɗu dokuk Israayel, ɓooɓa waaɗee ɓay kiñin kiŋ ɗe ɓa kaaniɗ. »
Suseef kurukka, a ɓayya kuɓka na yaay ɓa, a haadda Israayel.
Waaye wa a kerah ne e Arkelawus namsiɗ baab ɓa Herod ŋ hafaŋ kur kaŋ Yudee, a neƴƴohha kaɗ nga. Heɗ ɓoo woytohha ɗe ŋ heeƴ, ŋ ineem, a kaɗta Galile,
a gennda nga, ŋ kur ka na woyse Nasareet. Ina woosuuɗ ci woyee raakka, ne Mucɗohi Gapohse ɓeeɗkohsan ƴaariŋ ɓi Nasareet

footnotes.text: Musaa : woosuuɗi Musaa, a yi farañse na woye "Moïse". A raaku ŋ jamanoona Israayel ca tumohu ñaam ŋ Misra weɗ "Egypte" woti-woti (Pula 2:1-10). Musaa yeem, Kooh adgiɗee ɗe ne a pulɗoh Israayel ca ŋ kiñaamka ɓa nikohe (Pula 3:10). Wi a puliɗ ɓa, Kooh eɗta ɗe ɓi nakoh laayiɗ ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ findi ɓa joy ɗe ñaamkoh na findi ɓa joy pesoh ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa. Musaa a yi fiis teereeci yatuus ci koc ŋ Biibali ci na woyse "Tawreet", wala "waasiŋ Musaa".

waasiŋ Musaa : e teereeci yatuus ci koc ngaŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci ; ceem ceɗ na woyse Tawreet. Ca na woye findi Adina ferohu, hayiŋ bakaaɗ na kakaan, gaalaŋ Noohin na ambtiɗohi Kooh tufkiɗ na adinaani jen, ɓeeɗkiŋ Kooh na Ibrahiima, na ambtiɗohi a tufkiɗ na ɗe na ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe, cambohaaniŋ cuuɓiŋ Israayel, na ambtiɗohi Kooh tufkiɗ na ɓa. Ŋ ɗooƴ ambtiɗoheem, Kooh gapeen ɓa ɓi in laayiɗ, te a nameen ɓa eɗ nakoh ciŋ ɗe.
miir: wa cuuraay, wa na fuuɗseeɗi. Wa na woyse "myrrhe" ŋ farañse.
Mucɗohi Gapohse ɓeeɗkohsan ƴaariŋ ɓi Nasareet : Ŋ Fiis ci ɗeɓgaan, ɗiski woo ki puloh, wa inhuuɗi.
